name: mm_tax_recap_target_leverage_share_price
question_template: Use exact arithmetic. A firm with existing perpetual debt D0={D0} USD million and current total firm value V={V} USD million has N={N} million shares outstanding. The corporate tax rate is T={T} percent and Modigliani-Miller with taxes holds: each USD of additional perpetual debt adds T USD of tax shield to firm value. The firm announces a recapitalisation: it issues new perpetual debt and uses all proceeds to repurchase shares at the post-announcement price, which fully reflects the added tax shield. The new debt is sized so that total debt (existing plus new) divided by post-recapitalisation equity value equals the target ratio L={L}. The disclosed inputs always imply a strictly positive new debt issue. Compute the post-announcement share price in USD.

slots.description: New perpetual debt issued in USD million.
Firm value added by the new tax shield.
Equity value after debt issue and buyback.
Shares bought back, in millions of shares.

program:
def solve():
    V = Q(P["V"])
    D0 = Q(P["D0"])
    N = Q(P["N"])
    t = Q(P["T"]) / 100
    L = Q(P["L"])
    denom = 1 + L - L * t
    dD = (L * (V - D0) - D0) / denom
    if dD <= 0:
        raise ValueError("target leverage already met or exceeded by existing debt")
    shield = t * dD
    VL = V + shield
    E_post = VL - D0 - dD
    if E_post <= 0:
        raise ValueError("non-positive post-recap equity")
    price = (VL - D0) / N
    shares_rep = dD / price
    if shares_rep >= N:
        raise ValueError("buyback exceeds shares outstanding")
    return {
        "final": price,
        "new_debt_issued": dD,
        "tax_shield_added": shield,
        "post_recap_equity_value": E_post,
        "shares_repurchased_millions": shares_rep,
    }
